blocks.text:
`Gtk::Scale` widgets (or "sliders") allow the user to
visually select and manipulate a value within a specific range. You
might use one, for instance, to adjust the
magnification level on a zoomed preview of a picture, or to control
the brightness of a colour, or to specify the number of minutes of
inactivity before a screensaver takes over the screen.
blocks.zh: `Gtk::Scale` 控件（也称「滑块」）让用户以可视化的方式在给定范围内选取和调整一个数值。比如可以把它接到一个微调按钮（spin button）上，也可以在显示字体尺寸预览时用它调节字号。

blocks.text:
As with `Scrollbar`s, the orientation can be either
horizontal or vertical. The default constructor creates an
`Adjustment` with all of its values set to
`0.0`. This isn't useful so you will need to set some
`Adjustment` details to get meaningful behavior.
blocks.zh: 与 `Scrollbar` 一样，Scale 的方向可以是水平或垂直。默认构造函数创建的 `Adjustment` 具有默认取值。

blocks.text:
`Scale` widgets can display their current value as a number
next to the trough. By default they show the value, but you can change this
with the set_draw_value() method.
blocks.zh: `Scale` 控件可以在滑槽旁边以数字形式显示当前值。默认会显示该值，可以通过 set_draw_value() 方法改变这一行为。

blocks.text:
The value displayed by a scale widget is rounded to one decimal point
by default, as is the `value` field in its
`Gtk::Adjustment`. You can change this with the
set_digits() method.
blocks.zh: Scale 控件显示的数值默认四舍五入到小数点后一位，其 `Gtk::Adjustment` 里的 `value` 字段也是如此。可以用 set_digits() 修改这个位数。

blocks.text:
Also, the value can be drawn in different positions relative to the trough,
specified by the set_value_pos() method.
blocks.zh: 此外，数值相对滑槽的绘制位置可以通过 set_value_pos() 方法调整（如顶部、底部、左侧、右侧）。
